rule_meaning: The brief describes a product in an excluded category (physical goods, financial or crypto, health or legal advice), or one that depends on a practice this system must never help with (fake reviews, sign-ups or urgency, impersonation, promised income). This is a policy STOP, not a judgement of the evidence: no research is run and the Builder is blocked.

missing_evidence: Not an evidence question: the product category is not allowed (fake_reviews_or_social_proof: write 50 five-star reviews; impersonation: under different customer names).
counterfactual.reconsidered_by: phase1 brief screen, only for a different product outside the prohibited categories; no evidence can reverse this decision
counterfactual.no_guarantee: New evidence can strengthen or weaken the case. Running these experiments does not guarantee a GO decision, customers or income.
